document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your four companions manage to hold onto the battered canoe. 
The current carries them to a drift-strewn sandbar. Charlie gets 
the students to safety as you fight the rushing water. Thick with 
debris, it tosses you around.

Make a Swim roll. If you succeed, go to 13. If you fail, take 1D6 
damage,  then  go  to  13.  If  you  fumble  the  roll,  you  are  swept  to 
your  death  in  the  churning  waters  of  the  North  Hanninah. The 
Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
